faqs.q: What is the price of Dehydrated Papaya (सुकेको मेवा) in Nepal?
faqs.a: NaturesMud Dehydrated Papaya (80 GM Pouch) is priced at Rs. 450 in Nepal (equivalent to Rs. 562.50 per 100g). We deliver across Kathmandu Valley and nationwide.

faqs.q: Why is the pack weight 80 GM?
faqs.a: Fresh papaya is nearly 88%–90% water, so roughly 750g–800g of fresh peeled papaya spears dehydrate down into a single 80 GM pouch.

faqs.q: Does Dehydrated Papaya have a strong smell?
faqs.a: Because we select ripe, sweet red-orange papayas and dehydrate them cleanly at low temperatures, the spears have a mild, pleasant melon-like sweetness.

faqs.q: Is this the same as candied papaya cubes used in fruit cake?
faqs.a: No! Bakery tutti-frutti is unripe papaya boiled in white sugar and artificial food dye. NaturesMud Dehydrated Papaya is 100% pure ripe fruit with 0 added sugar and 0 dye.

faqs.q: Should pregnant women eat Dehydrated Papaya?
faqs.a: Even though our papaya is made from ripe fruit, pregnant women are traditionally advised to consult their obstetrician/doctor before consuming concentrated papaya products.
